keyEvents.text: Goal! Dinamo Zagreb 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1. Malik Tillman (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Mislav Orsic (Dinamo Zagreb).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Dinamo Zagreb 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2. Jarell Quansah (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Moussa Diaby.
First Half ends, Dinamo Zagreb 0, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2.
Substitution, Dinamo Zagreb. Arbër Hoxha replaces Mateo Lisica.
Lukas Kacavenda (Dinamo Zagreb) is shown the yellow card.
Luka Stojkovic (Dinamo Zagreb) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Nathan Tella replaces Ibrahim Maza.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Christian Kofane replaces Patrik Schick.
Substitution, Dinamo Zagreb. Kirill Kravtsov replaces Lukas Kacavenda.
Substitution, Dinamo Zagreb. Luka Ivanusec replaces Josip Misic.
Substitution, Dinamo Zagreb. Dani Rodríguez replaces Mislav Orsic.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Edmond Tapsoba replaces Miguel Gutiérrez.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Jonas Hofmann replaces Moussa Diaby.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Guéla Doué replaces Jarell Quansah.
Kirill Kravtsov (Dinamo Zagreb) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Loïc Badé (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Dinamo Zagreb. Noa Mikic replaces Moris Valincic.
